user.title: Tankerkönig Mobile
user.description: The home location is taken from the Home Assistant configuration.

data_description.radius_km: Applies to home and on the road. Max. 25 km (API limit).
data_description.scan_interval_min: Regular update. On the road only while the vehicle is parked. Tankerkönig allows at most one request every 5 minutes.
data_description.fixed_times: Times in 24-hour format HH:MM (e.g. 06:00, 12:00, 18:30), separated by comma or newline. Prices are always fetched at these times – on the road only while parked. Empty = no fixed times.

home.name: Home
home.description: Settings that only apply to the home location.

data_description.station_filter: Applies to home only – on the road all stations within the radius are returned. Station IDs or brands (e.g. ARAL, JET), separated by comma or newline. Empty = all stations.

data_description.tracker_entity: device_tracker (or person/zone) with latitude/longitude attributes. Required for prices on the road.
data_description.pause_zones: While the vehicle is inside this zone (e.g. home), no prices are fetched on the road. Entering it triggers an immediate home update.
data_description.dwell_min: Minutes the vehicle must stay at the same place before prices are fetched. Afterwards the update interval applies until it moves again. No requests while driving.
data_description.stationary_tolerance_m: Movements below this distance (GPS inaccuracy) do not count as a change of location.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Tankerkönig API.
error.no_location: Enable at least one location (home or on the road).
error.tracker_required: Select a location entity in the “On the road” section.
error.invalid_time: Invalid fixed update time. Use the 24-hour format HH:MM, e.g. 18:30.
